oracle_namespaces.description: Oracle Corporation/Oracle America legal material, including Google LLC v. Oracle America, Inc.
Historical RAFAELIA nomenclature found in image/conversation interpretations together with Atlas Cognitivo Modular, DeepVoice Mirror and Z-Core Sound Engine.

legal_authorities.supported: Protection of literary and artistic works and rights of authors.
legal_authorities.boundary: Does not establish patentability or ownership of abstract ideas or mathematical concepts.

legal_authorities.supported: Computer programs are protected as literary works; qualifying original data compilations may be protected based on selection or arrangement.
legal_authorities.boundary: Compilation protection does not automatically extend to underlying data.

legal_authorities.supported: Copyright protection extends to expressions, not ideas, procedures, methods of operation or mathematical concepts as such.
legal_authorities.boundary: Abstract RAFAELIA formulas, methods or concepts require separate protection and novelty analysis.

legal_authorities.supported: Right to request review of solely automated personal-data decisions affecting the data subject's interests and obtain information on criteria/procedures subject to statutory limits.
legal_authorities.boundary: Does not prove that a specific platform performed discriminatory or targeted automated treatment.

legal_authorities.supported: Brazil is a Party to the Convention on Cybercrime, with accession deposited in 2022 and applicability from 2023.
legal_authorities.boundary: Treaty status does not classify a private service failure as cybercrime.

legal_authorities.supported: Current Council of Europe material does not show Brazil as a signed/ratified Party to Convention 108; 2026 material discusses observer/pre-evaluation interest regarding Convention 108+.
legal_authorities.boundary: Do not represent Convention 108/108+ as an already-binding treaty obligation on Brazil as a Party.

systemic_blocking_types.promotion_rule: May be established by reproducible mechanism, logs and failure evidence.
Requires platform/organization policy evidence or reproducible rule-based behavior.
Requires controlled comparison, repeatability and exclusion of ordinary explanations.
Requires stronger evidence of targeting/intent; differential treatment alone is insufficient.

hypotheses.H0: Observed failures are explained by general rules, ordinary technical faults, capacity limits, random variation or content-independent policy application.
hypotheses.H1: There is reproducible differential automated treatment associated with a defined account/content/context variable.
hypotheses.H2_targeted_persecution: Intentional or coordinated targeting; remains separate and requires evidence beyond differential treatment.

anti_regression: user report is evidence of the report, not automatically of external cause
treaty existence != automatic applicability to every dispute
copyright != patent != trade secret != license != scientific priority
Oracle 4EYE != Oracle Corporation without explicit evidence
corrections append and historical bytes remain preserved
